```{r}
#| label: tbl-emp-price
#| tbl-cap: "Price proxies for empirical data."

price_tbl_display <- tribble(
  ~product_code, ~product, ~proxy_price_usd,
  "AS27000", "Microgynon / pill", 0.220,
  "AS27132", "Microlut", 0.288,
  "AS27133", "Depo Provera injectable", 0.637,
  "AS27134", "Noristerat injectable", 0.637,
  "AS27138", "Implanon", 10.500,
  "AS27137", "Jadelle", 8.520,
  "AS42018", "Copper T IUD", 0.393,
  "AS46000", "Male condom", 0.030,
  "AS17005", "Female condom", 0.490
)

price_tbl_display |>
  mutate(
    proxy_price_usd = sprintf("%.3f", proxy_price_usd)
  ) |>
  rename(
    `Product code` = product_code,
    `Product` = product,
    `Proxy unit price (USD)` = proxy_price_usd
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("scale_down", "repeat_header"),
    font_size = 8
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, "7em") |>
  column_spec(2, "14em") |>
  column_spec(3, "8em")
```
